issues.legal_issue: A delay in challenging the denial of additional transferable development rights does not amount to abandonment when the right to claim those rights remained in suspended animation pending resolution of a challenge to the policy underlying the denial.

An owner who surrenders land for transferable development rights is entitled to additional transferable development rights only if the owner develops or constructs the reserved amenity on the surrendered land at the owner's cost in accordance with the applicable regulations.

Works undertaken to secure acceptance of a land surrender and the grant of ordinary transferable development rights do not constitute development of an amenity entitling the owner to additional transferable development rights.
